column3: Close to the Hebrew; נְרַנְּנָה (“shout for joy”) is rendered “let us sing,” and “Rock” is capitalized.
Close to the Hebrew; בִּזְמִרוֹת (“with songs”) is rendered “with psalms.”
Close to the Hebrew; “the peaks of the mountains” is rendered “The heights of the hills.”
Close to the Hebrew; נִשְׁתַּחֲוֶה (“prostrate ourselves”) is rendered “let us worship.”
Close to the Hebrew; “the flock of his hand” is rendered “the sheep of His hand.”
Close to the Hebrew; the place names “Meribah” and “Massah” are translated “the rebellion” and “the day of trial.”
Close to the Hebrew; אָקוּט (“I loathed”) is rendered “I was grieved,” and NKJV supplies “that.”
Close to the Hebrew; the oath formula “if they enter” is rendered “They shall not enter.”
